shared_elements: vertical, stacked arrangement of figures one above another
animal head shown in profile with open jaws
arms/forelimbs bent with hands or paws
row or band of repeated short parallel marks (teeth-like / hatched band)
figure crouching or perched at the lower part
justification: Both are tall, pale stone monuments organised as a vertical stack of superimposed creatures, each including a frontal human-like head, a profile animal head with bared teeth, and a horizontal band of repeated short strokes, which is a fairly specific shared compositional habit. The decisive difference is technique and viewpoint: A is a fully three-dimensional sculpture in the round with deeply modelled, rounded volumes, while B is a flat slab bearing shallow, linear low relief with animals in strict profile, so the hands are clearly not the same.
